title: Leaving Cab in 1939: Dandridge side date, then Europe as war begins
summary: Albertson recalls his 1936 side date with Putney Dandridge, Teddy Wilson and Big Sid Catlett. He left Cab in 1939 to live in Europe, the war began as his ship blacked out, and he stayed in Paris playing for the Hot Club of France and recording for Swing, and later with Eartha Kitt in 1950.
